name: Great Red Sand: Crown
description:
A Card Back won by achieving excellent results in open Genius Invokation TCG tournaments.
Under the white-hot light of the blazing sun, the crystalline grains of the Great Red Sand glitter like molten gold, and the treasures buried deep beneath call out to the hearts of countless adventurers...
